fullDesc: In 2001 Barry Bonds of the San Francisco Giants hit 73 home runs, breaking Mark McGwire's single-season record of 70. His achievements are linked to debate over performance-enhancing drugs in baseball.
realFacts: He passed Hank Aaron's career record in 2007
He finished with 762 career home runs
He has not been elected to the Hall of Fame
He was convicted of obstruction of justice, later overturned
